name: transforms-bland-dashboard-with-a-clear-signature
prompt: Propose a visibly distinctive but coherent visual direction and implementation and verification plan for a bland, default-looking Flutter analytics dashboard on phone and desktop. There is no brand brief or runnable project supplied yet, so do not claim rendered results.
expectations: defines a specific design signature and clear information hierarchy before styling components
centralizes semantic roles in ThemeData, ColorScheme, TextTheme, or equivalent tokens instead of scattering literals through widgets or adding a design package
audits default-looking Material composition and uses only a coherent subset of expressive treatments rather than effect overload or a card around every metric
defines realistic populated and edge-state fixtures plus a phone and desktop render-critique-render plan without claiming unavailable evidence

name: preserves-existing-brand-system
prompt: Describe a concrete implementation and visual-verification approach for polishing one checkout screen in a supplied Flutter repository that already has custom ThemeData, ColorScheme, TextTheme, shared checkout components, and stable before-state fixtures. Do not claim that you rendered files that are not present in this eval prompt.
expectations: makes inspection and preservation of the established brand and component vocabulary the first implementation constraint
reuses existing semantic tokens and extends them only where a stable product concept is missing

expectations.text: rules out a second theme system, font, icon pack, or UI dependency without evidence

expectations: defines an equivalent stable before-and-after fixture comparison without fabricating rendered results

name: adapts-ios-reference-across-platforms
prompt: Adapt a supplied polished iOS Todo dashboard into Flutter for iPhone, Android, and web. The reference has an atmospheric lavender-cyan background, translucent layered surfaces, a large gradient product title, a compact progress ring, icon filter pills, realistic populated tasks, spring feedback, and an integrated glass bottom action dock. Provide a concrete translation and verification approach without claiming that you rendered the unavailable Flutter project.
expectations: extracts the reference's design signature, visual ambition, hierarchy, density, rhythm, state coverage, and brand tone
adapts controls, navigation, typography, gestures, and input feedback to each target platform
maps transferable material, depth, background, and motion intent to maintainable Flutter primitives without blindly cloning iOS-only fonts, icons, chrome, or gestures
compares equivalent populated and edge-state fixtures across touch, pointer, keyboard, compact, and wide contexts and performs a visual critique iteration

name: structure-only-refactor-is-not-redesign
prompt: Split this 500-line Flutter screen into maintainable widgets but keep it pixel-identical.
expectations: keeps widget extraction and state ownership changes structural and behavior-preserving
preserves the current visual system and rendered output

expectations.text: does not expand a structural refactor into an unauthorized redesign

name: designs-complete-data-states
prompt: Design a production-ready API-backed catalog screen with loading, empty, error, offline, disabled, and loaded states.
expectations: keeps composition stable across asynchronous states where practical
makes recovery actionable and gives each surface one clear primary action
uses realistic long content and distinguishes empty, failure, offline, and stale conditions
defines explicit verification for light and dark themes, text scaling, contrast, and representative form factors without fabricating unavailable rendered evidence
